transcript.text: Your agent knows TYPO3, but not how good TYPO3 work is done.
typo3-skills: 61 skills for coding agents, in 12 groups.
One clone, one install script: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini.
The TYPO3 Dev Companion gives your agent version-aware TYPO3 knowledge. Our skills add whole jobs on top.
Twelve groups: upgrades, content, editing, design, accessibility, search and security.
They build on what the community teaches, at MTUG and TYPO3camp München.
The upgrade run follows a sealed graph of 72 nodes and 206 edges.
Find a skill in seconds: search, filter by group, copy the install line.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
